news_cards.title: Bihar ke Kisanon ko Hari Mirch ki Kheti par 24,000 tak Anudan
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne kisanon ko hari mirch ki kheti par anudan dena shuru kiya hai
Is yojana ke tahat kisanon ko 24,000 tak ka anudan diya jayega
Yeh anudan kisanon ko hari mirch ki kheti ke liye pratsahit karne ke liye diya ja raha hai

news_cards.title: Mithila Makhana ko GI Tag Mila, Australia ko Hua Pehla Samudri Pardesh
bullets: Mithila makhana ko GI tag mila hai, jisse iski pehchan aur mauka badhega
Iske baad Mithila makhana ka pehla samudri pardesh Australia ko hua hai
Yeh GI tag Mithila makhana ki gunvatta aur vishishtata ko darshata hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Museum ka Sthapana Divas par Antarrashtriya Lok Kala Pradarshani
bullets: Bihar museum ka sthapana divas manaya ja raha hai, jiske avsar par antarrashtriya lok kala pradarshani aayojit ki ja rahi hai
Is pradarshani mein vibhinn deshon ke kalakar apni rachnaon ko pradarshit karenge
Yeh pradarshani Bihar ke sanskriti aur kala ko badhava dena ka ek prayaas hai

news_cards.title: Bihar mein TRE-4 ke Liye Roster Clearance Shuru, Shikshak Bharti ki Taiyari
bullets: Bihar mein TRE-4 ke liye roster clearance shuru ho gaya hai, jiske tahat shikshak bharti ki taiyari ki ja rahi hai
Is bharti ke liye kai jilon se kkhali padon ka byora mangaya gaya hai
Yeh bharti Bihar ke shiksha vibhag dwara ki ja rahi hai

news_cards.title: Bihar mein 125 Din Rozgar Guarantee Yojana aur PM Surya Ghar Yojana par Bhaichara
bullets: Bihar mein 125 din rozgar guarantee yojana aur PM surya ghar yojana par bhaichara hua hai
Is yojana ke tahat garibon ko rozgar aur ghar dilane ki koshish ki ja rahi hai
Yeh yojana Bihar ke garibon ke liye ek mahatvapoorn kadam hai

news_cards.title: Ma Janki Punauradham Mandir ka Nirmaan 2028 tak Pura Hoga
bullets: Ma Janki Punauradham mandir ka nirmaan 2028 tak pura hoga, jiske liye kaam jari hai
Is mandir ke nirmaan ke liye kai karodon rupaye ka nivesh kiya ja raha hai
Yeh mandir Bihar ke dharmik sthalon mein se ek hoga
